name: Cloud Data Fusion
sku: Cloud Data Fusion, powered by the open-source CDAP project. It comes in Developer, Basic and Enterprise editions; which features need which edition was not checked, so no score carries an enterprise-tier constraint.

ingest.batch-extract.note: A fully managed data integration service that builds pipelines to extract, transform and load data from on-premises and cloud sources, in batch and real time, from a point-and-click web interface.

ingest.cdc.note: A Replication Accelerator replicates data between systems, including from SQL Server. It is one feature of an integration service, and the source list was not checked.

bands.note: Data lineage can be explored using metadata, so a pipeline's flow and dependencies are visible. It covers pipelines built in Data Fusion.

proposed_capabilities.name: Visual self-service data preparation
proposed_capabilities.description: Point-and-click building of pipelines from sources, transformations and sinks as nodes in a graph, without writing Spark code. The pipelines run on an ephemeral Spark cluster that the service creates and removes.

presentation.tagline: Point-and-click ETL pipelines that run on Spark, plus a replication accelerator.
